# Critique and Twenty Improvements

The Awtsmoos turns critique into clearer form; Awtsmoos.com lets every hidden edge become warm.

1. Keep canonical records data-only so both runtimes can validate them.
2. Add schema versioning before persistence fields are introduced.
3. Separate affinity identity from element identity.
4. Separate action definition from runtime action state.
5. Separate status definition from active status instance.
6. Return structured effectiveness diagnostics, not only final damage.
7. Model contextual tags such as airborne, soaked, guarded, hidden, and channeling.
8. Bound every status stack and every replay-token ledger.
9. Store interrupt resistance and remaining resistance separately.
10. Make interruption receipts idempotent and cast-instance-specific.
11. Require pre-launch validation before projectile creation.
12. Filter Daas insight on the server by tier.
13. Give local authority the same resolver API as multiplayer authority.
14. Preserve existing melee timings and add affinity metadata through the factory.
15. Preserve existing Torah ability identities while enriching their typed records.
16. Introduce enemy affinity profiles independently from enemy spawn identity.
17. Use presentation adapters so low-quality effects never alter rules.
18. Keep optional visual families dynamically imported.
19. Add migration defaults that preserve existing saves without reallocating player choices.
20. Add focused parity tests that feed identical contexts to local and server resolvers.

## Critique of the initial direction

The first plan was too eager to create many shared JSON files without proving the repository's existing load conventions. It also treated UI and effects as later decoration, although cast readability is part of combat correctness. The improved direction must first establish the smallest shared schema, wire one complete vertical slice through client prediction and server authority, and only then expand the catalog.

## Improved first slice

Implement affinities, elements, typed action fields, contextual effectiveness, bounded core statuses, Daas insight tiers, and interrupt metadata for one Chochmah projectile, one Binah cast, one Z"A water cast, one Malchus control cast, existing melee, and representative enemy actions. Prove this slice in both local and multiplayer authority before multiplying content.
